title: E-MTR-0003: stand-in hydrogen on the husk against Fock $S^3$: the shells split as the husk cubic group $O_h$...
purpose: Experiment E-MTR-0003 in the quantum arena: stand-in hydrogen on the husk against Fock $S^3$: the shells split as the husk cubic group $O_h$ predicts (1 + 3 and 1 + 2 + 3 + 3), with no remnant of 2T, W(D4) or W(F4), whose restrictions would keep 2s with 2p or 3s with the Eg half of 3d.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
